hooks.command: input=$(cat); raw=$(printf '%s' "$input" | grep -o '"file_path"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed -E 's/.*:[[:space:]]*"//; s/"$//'); clean=$(printf '%s' "$raw" | tr -d '\\'); case "$clean" in P:Gamespuffins-main*|/p/Games/puffins-main/*) cd "/p/Games/puffins-main" 2>/dev/null && git add -A 2>/dev/null; git commit -m "auto: update via Claude Code" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; git push origin main >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;; esac; exit 0
